definitions.explanation: The look and feel of a material or surface — how something feels to the touch or appears in terms of material quality. Commonly used in fashion, design, and product descriptions.

examples.english: This leather has a nice texture.

examples.japanese: ⟦{高級|こうきゅう}→高級：08644_koukyuu⟧な{質感|しつかん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{生地|きじ}→生地：02631_kiji⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}っている→使う：00473_tsukau⟧。
examples.english: It uses fabric with a luxurious feel.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{塗料|とりょう}→塗料：24548_toryou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}えば→使う：00473_tsukau⟧、⟦{木|き}→木：00524_ki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{質感|しつかん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{活|い}かした→活かす：10422_ikasu⟧⟦{仕上|しあ}がり→仕上がり：07432_shiagari⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: Using this paint will give a finish that brings out the texture of the wood.

notes:
{質感|しつかん} describes the tactile or visual quality of a material — how it feels to the touch or looks in terms of texture and substance.

ETYMOLOGY:
Combines ⟦{質|しつ}→質：01425_shitsu⟧ (quality, substance) + ⟦{感|かん}→〜感：28578_kan⟧ (feeling, sensation).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {質感|しつかん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧: has a nice texture/feel
- {質感|しつかん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧: feels high-quality
- {質感|しつかん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{活|い}かす→活かす：10422_ikasu⟧: to bring out the texture
- {質感|しつかん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧: having good texture

DOMAINS:
Frequently used in fashion, interior design, product reviews, and visual arts. In CG graphics and photography, it refers to how realistic a surface appears.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{手触|てざわ}り→手触り：12758_tezawari⟧: how something feels to the touch (purely tactile)
- ⟦{肌触|はだざわ}り→肌触り：06637_hadazawari⟧: feel against the skin (fabric, sheets)
